audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Labeled RSC weighting does not descend through the full unoriented stabilizer; Lemma4.8 has no bound depending only on the input inradius and bi-Lipschitz constant; Lemma2.5 ratio-one short-arc asymptotic is false
limitations: M25-0102-P1 — Labeled RSC weighting does not descend through the full unoriented stabilizer — Counterevidence: Section7.3 expressly introduces ordered oriented curves and Stab_0 and acknowledges the labeling obstruction. This supports an intended oriented formulation, not the literal earlier descent.

M25-0102-P1 — Labeled RSC weighting does not descend through the full unoriented stabilizer — Limits: Exact definitions, descent/count identities and the counterexample are checked; the whole corrected global convergence theorem is not reproved.

M25-0102-P2 — Lemma4.8 has no bound depending only on the input inradius and bi-Lipschitz constant — Counterevidence: In the actual fixed-genus thick-surface application, the target inradius is independently bounded. The counterfamily lacks that additional bound and does not refute Proposition4.2.

M25-0102-P2 — Lemma4.8 has no bound depending only on the input inradius and bi-Lipschitz constant — Limits: False general lemma and actual missing proof hypothesis are confirmed; no counterexample to the paper's main convergence theorem is claimed. Analytic small-epsilon strengthening is not misrepresented as a new numerical run.

M25-0102-P3 — Lemma2.5 ratio-one short-arc asymptotic is false — Counterevidence: The actual cited Calderon-Farre published Lemma6.6 provides the sufficient inequalities; these were inspected and their exact substitutions into downstream estimates were supplied.
M25-0102-P3 — Lemma2.5 ratio-one short-arc asymptotic is false — Limits: No universal corrected ratio two is asserted.
Counterevidence: The later ordered/oriented Stab0 construction identifies a consistent intended formulation but does not validate the earlier literal full-stabilizer claim.
Counterevidence: Thick compact-surface applications have both inradii bounded; the geometric conclusion in that restricted application is not refuted.

Limitations: No full corrected equidistribution theorem or unrelated argument recertification. Exact publisher version retained. Existing successful build and eight actual report-page inspections reused after source/TeX/compiler/dependency/PDF/image and identity checks.
Limits: Background theorems are checked at the application level, not wholly reproved.
Limits: General train-track classification and all compactness results are not freshly derived.
Limits: Counterfamily does not refute Proposition4.2 with the repaired target-radius hypothesis.
Limits: Measure chain is conditional on a valid invariant quotient weight; no whole-proof reproduction of external ergodic theorems.
Limits: The original same-facet extrema are not assumed continuous; no unproved RSC Borel extension is used.
Limits: No full reproof of every general-multicurve convergence conclusion.
Limits: No certification of arbitrary nonproper Gromov-hyperbolic spaces.
Limits: No exhaustive erratum history or author/journal byte equivalence claim.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
In Section 1.1, curves are unoriented free homotopy classes, and \(s(X,\gamma,L)\) counts their mapping-class orbit up to length \(L\). In Section 2.6, \(\mathcal{MRG}_{h,b}\) has distinctly labeled boundary components. Cutting a nonseparating curve in genus \(g\) gives type \((g-1,2)\). Write \[Z=\mathcal{MRG}_{g-1,2}(1,1),\qquad \tau:Z\longrightarrow Z\] for the involution exchanging its boundary labels. An orientation of the curve distinguishes its sides. The full stabilizer \(\operatorname{Stab}(\gamma)\) contains orientation-reversing-on-the-curve mapping classes, whereas \(\operatorname{Stab}_0(\gamma)\) preserves that orientation.

Recorded check: Labeled RSC weighting does not descend through the full unoriented stabilizer
